company_name: HANGZHOU COBETTER FILTRATION EQUIPMENT CO., LTD.
semiconductor_relevance: High — Cobetter specializes in filtration equipment and materials essential for semiconductor manufacturing processes.
summary: Hangzhou Cobetter Filtration Equipment Co., Ltd. is a manufacturer of filtration systems and components, focusing on high-quality filters and purifiers for the semiconductor and display industries. With a strong emphasis on research and development, the company aims to provide cost-effective solutions that enhance product quality for its clients.

regional_presence.Korea: Cobetter established a subsidiary in Korea in 2019 to enhance customer support and collaboration for quality improvement and cost reduction.
